_comment: chaos952 (id 935) SearchBrain profile. Schema = bot/profiles/example.json. Weights are multipliers (default 1.0); chainUnit/comboUnit/futureDiscount/actMargin are absolute (defaults 60/15/0.7/1.0). Grounded in corpus (analyze_strategy + re-sim offense fingerprint).

_meta.style: COMBO-PRESSURE: combo-dominant (72% combo / 28% chain), shallow chains (med 4 / peak 7), wins by volume over longer games; digs garbage PROACTIVELY; fast/active (apm 406, swap 21%).
_meta.knobRationale: comboUnit up (combo-happy) + w_breakGarbage up (proactive dig) + w_survival up (keeps board low) + actMargin down (acts readily); w_chain/futureDiscount down (shallow chains, bird-in-hand).

offenseDetail.pattern: steady stream of SMALL 1-tall combos (~1 every ~2.5s); few deep chains
